reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing shared linkExternalAccount and assertBankAccountNotLinked so every provider gets it, but the holder's unlink is a copy of unlinkAccount's field reset rather than a shared helper.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block clearing account_id, bank, balances, sync source and status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: The behaviour lives in the shared link path (linkExternalAccount) after the closed-account check and before any write, which is where the tree decides link preconditions.

scope.why: Only the link parameter type, the precondition helper and the shared link path change.

maintainability.why: Works for all providers through one path, but the 'assert' helper now conditionally returns an id (a confusing contract), and if the definition of an unlinked account changes, two copies must be updated.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/accounts/app.ts linkExternalAccount re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount (db.updateAccount clearing the link fields) instead of extracting it from unlinkAccount into a helper both use.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink field reset is verbatim, not reshaped.
